readiness.hed: A weekend system brings scattered rain and snow showers to Fredericksburg tonight into Sunday, with highs near 55-56 and lows dipping into the low-to-mid 30s, before clearing out for a sunny Monday
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Scattered rain showers move in through this evening, then mix with snow showers overnight into Sunday morning as the low near 34 sets in; Sunday itself stays mixed with more rain and snow showers under a high near 56. Showers taper off Sunday evening, clearing the way for a sunny Monday with a high near 59 and a clear, cold night near 30. No accumulation is expected given the brief, scattered nature of the showers and above-freezing afternoon temperatures.
actions: Showers mixing with snow tonight and Sunday morning should stay light and non-accumulating, but bridges and overpasses can still get slick — drive with extra caution after dark.
Northwest winds gusting to 25 mph this afternoon mean loose outdoor items, trash cans and holiday decorations should be secured before dark.
Overnight lows near freezing both tonight and Sunday night — keep sensitive plants and exposed pipes covered through the weekend.
Monday clears out dry and sunny with a high near 59, a good window for outdoor errands or yard work after a damp weekend.
